referenceSources.title: När Saab vann Pikes Peak | Vi Bilägare
referenceSources.description:
A striking red Saab 9-3 Viggen, bearing the number 93 and adorned with SAAB, Clarion, and ecopower logos, powers up a dusty mountain road. Its gold wheels spin through loose dirt, while the aerodynamic rear wing and rally-spec bodywork emphasize its hill climb pedigree. 

This photograph evokes the 2000 Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, where Per Eklund piloted a specially tuned Saab 9-3 Viggen to victory at over 4,000 meters altitude. Engineered by Trollspeed in Trollhättan, the car delivered more than 750 horsepower in thin air, marking a triumphant moment in Saab’s motorsport history.
